stages.name: Street / Stock Chassis
stages.description: Production shell and layout with simple, sequential upgrades that teach the build system.

stages.name: Street Race
stages.description: Stock body, gutted and caged. Parts become choices instead of numbered upgrades.

stages.name: Front-Half / Tube Chassis
stages.description: Front structure work, serious chassis changes and engine swaps with physical compatibility limits.

stages.name: Full Race Car
stages.description: Full race-car construction with much wider powertrain and chassis freedom.
